ModMetaData.name: Nelim's Japanese Homestead (unofficial)
ModMetaData.author: Udon - 1.6 port by nelim
ModMetaData.description:
UNOFFICIAL. This mod is published without the original author's explicit consent. If the original author contacts me to request its removal, I undertake to take it down promptly.
A RimWorld 1.6 revival of "WA v1.0" by Udon, which never left 1.0. Japanese architecture, furniture, gardens, pastimes, clothing and crops.
What it adds: - Walls, ramparts, moats, steps, fusuma sliding doors (9 patterns) and shoji screens (4 patterns). - Tatami mats (9 shades), raked garden gravel (5 stones), moss. - Futons (39 variants), zabuton cushions (8 colours), tokonoma alcoves (6 patterns), folding screens, an aquarium. - Irori sunken hearths, which both cook and give a fire to sit by; a tea cauldron; a sutra-copying desk. - Lighting: andon, bonbori, chochin and ariake lanterns, braziers, a bonfire. - Pastimes: koto, karuta, kai-awase, sugoroku, an incense burner, and the tea ceremony. - 17 kimono outfits and headwear, on their own apparel layer. The princess kimono heartens allies around its wearer; the wrestler's kimono cows enemies. - Crops: azuki beans, tea bushes, igusa rush, kozo and mulberry - plus ten confections and green tea.
What the port changes: - The two Udon base mods WA relied on, ResourcePackCore and HealthDifferenceAuraCore, are replaced here. They are replaced inside this mod: dirt, charcoal, washi paper and pure silk are redefined here with their recipes, and the aura carried by the two special kimonos is rewritten in C# for 1.6. - The aquarium used to cost glass cullet, which no longer exists. It costs steel instead, and switches back to glass when Glass+Lights is installed. - Thirteen buildings carried a component the game dropped after 1.0. Left alone, it would have taken down their whole def. - The shogi board is not included: it already lives in Joy Preservation.
An unofficial revival. The textures and the original design belong to Udon - please do not republish without asking. See ATTRIBUTION.md.
Content mod: removing it mid-save deletes anything built from it.
